project_type.override_note: specify project type to apply type-specific rules. landing overrides css.font_size.pc from rem to px

text_node_mapping.one_node_one_element_note: each Figma TEXT node must map to its own HTML element, never merge adjacent TEXT nodes
text_node_mapping.forbid_merge_adjacent_note: two adjacent TEXT nodes with different styles must remain separate HTML elements

divider_bar.preserve_note: thin frames with fill-only (divider/bar/separator) must be kept as DOM elements, never dropped
divider_bar.detect: frame with width<=2 or height<=2 and has fills, no children or single RECTANGLE child

visibility_rule.exclude_only_note: only exclude nodes where visible is explicitly false. fill-only nodes, stroke-invisible nodes with fills, thin frames must all be preserved

decorative_nodes.preserve_note: background fills, decorative shapes, icons, dividers — all must map to DOM elements. never silently drop any visible node

border_stroke.border_from_stroke_only_note: CSS border-* properties must only be generated when the Figma node has strokes with visible===true
border_stroke.forbid_heuristic_border_note: never infer border from layout patterns or adjacent selectors (+). if Figma has no stroke, CSS must have no border
border_stroke.forbid_adjacent_selector_border_note: .card+.card{border-left:...} type inference is forbidden. use actual divider nodes instead
border_stroke.divider_is_node_not_border_note: Figma divider bars are independent nodes — render as HTML elements with background-color, not as CSS border on siblings

animation.gsap_fallback_note: if GSAP not loaded, data-delay elements must not remain invisible

bg_section.note: image-based sections: set height equal to original image pixel height and apply object-fit:cover

inline_img.note: img inside sections: use width:100% or % + aspect-ratio. never fixed px width/height

mobile_image.note: mobile-specific images must be used; sizing follows mobile image pixel dimensions

lazy_loading.note: loading=lazy is not required. do not add automatically

text_tag_selection.forbid_p_for_labels_note: short label text (brand names, keywords like BrainBody/MRI) must use span or heading, never p
text_tag_selection.heading_usage: use h1-h6 for actual section headings only, maintain sequential hierarchy

common_component_types.list_note: reusable list UI shared across pages: listType_1, listType_2, listType_3 ...
common_component_types.title_note: reusable title/heading block shared across pages: titleType_1, titleType_2 ...

state_classes.note: state classes do not require page prefix

exception_kebab.note: status prefix (is-, has-) and JS hook prefix (js-) may use kebab-case. all other classes must be snake_case

page_filename.class_prefix_rule: filename without .html extension becomes CSS class prefix

layout.forbid_layout_info_loss_note: layoutMode, itemSpacing, padding values from Figma must be reflected in CSS

project_init.note: must run before any project work. creates CLAUDE.md, settings, .gran-maestro structure

figma_mcp_workflow.method_note: use Figma MCP (get_figma_data) to fetch section-level node data. AI interprets MCP response directly. section-by-section calls keep context manageable for accurate interpretation

workflow.step1: get frame overview with shallow depth to identify sections
workflow.step2: for each section: call MCP with nodeId → AI interprets → generate HTML/CSS
workflow.step3: validate with validate-semantic.py (TODO: --type basic|landing 미지원, REQ-005+ 확장 필요)

figma_mcp_workflow.forbid_full_page_single_call_note: processing entire page in one MCP call produces lower quality. always split into sections
figma_mcp_workflow.forbid_plausible_values_note: if MCP response lacks a property, do not guess. only use values present in the response

optional_mapping_tool.note: optional: pipe MCP response to generate mapping.json for precise value validation

figma_mcp_workflow.validation_usage_note: TODO: validator 확장 필요 (REQ-005+) — --type basic|landing 미지원

coordinate_based_row.rule: boxes with same parent and matching y-coordinate + similar height → prefer inline-flex row layout
coordinate_based_row.note: when 2+ boxes share the same y position in the same parent, default to row (inline-flex) not vertical stack

agent_distribution.claude_role_note: Claude must only orchestrate/manage. code implementation must be outsourced to Codex or Gemini CLI
agent_distribution.forbid_claude_code_execution_note: using Task(subagent_type: general-purpose) for code implementation is forbidden. it only consumes Claude tokens without utilizing Codex/Gemini

publishing.primary_note: HTML/CSS publishing + Figma-to-code = 100% frontend. gemini-dev has frontend + large-context capabilities, ideal for large Figma JSON
publishing.codex_role_note: codex capabilities (code, refactor, test) are irrelevant for publishing projects

fullstack.note: split by layer: codex handles backend/API/DB, gemini handles frontend/UI

docs_config.note: small inline edits to md/json/config files only

agent_distribution.claude_direct_intervention: only after max_cli_retries exhausted for both primary and fallback agents

html.no_figure_figcaption_note: do not use
html.prefer_div_over_semantic_note: use <div> with class for sections/wrappers. <section> only for major content sections. avoid <main>, <article>, <figure>, <figcaption>
html.minimal_aria_note: use aria-label only on interactive elements without visible text. do not add aria-label to decorative wrappers or aria-hidden to spans
html.img_alt_concise_note: alt text should be short and descriptive (e.g. 'logo', 'product image'), not full Korean sentences

css.root_var_format: each variable on its own line inside :root{}
css.root_var_naming: point-color-N, font-color-N, --width, --padding pattern. do not use semantic names like --landing-dark, --landing-navy
css.selector_single_line_note: each selector rule on one line (.a{...}), never multi-line brace expansion
css.forbid_duplicate_selector_note: same selector must not appear multiple times. merge all properties into one rule

font_size.pc_note: PC breakpoint uses rem exclusively for font-size (basic project)
font_size.mobile_note: 768px and below uses fixed px for font-size
font_size.landing_override_note: landing project: both PC and mobile use fixed px for font-size. overrides pc:rem rule

line_height.format_note: always use unitless ratio (1.3, 1.45, 1.6). never use computed pixel values like 25.86600112915039px or 63.228px

letter_spacing.unit_note: default: use em units (-0.025em). fine-tuning exception: px allowed when value <= 2px absolute (e.g. -0.5px, -1px, -0.8px)

border_radius.circle_note: for circular elements use 50%, not 999px or large px values
border_radius.pill_note: for pill-shaped buttons/elements use 2em only. 50% is reserved for circle. 999px is always forbidden

css.clamp_policy: px < 100 fixed only, px >= 100 clamp allowed
css.no_raw_calc_note: calc() forbidden standalone. only permitted inside clamp() function
css.no_raw_vw_note: vw forbidden standalone. only permitted inside clamp() function

max_function.note: max() function is allowed for responsive sizing. primary pattern: max(calc(N/1920*100vw), Npx) where N is design value

mobile_spacing_policy.applies_to_note: landing uses explicit px values, not half rule
mobile_spacing_policy.note: 768px and below: padding/margin defaults to half of PC value for basic projects

css.no_important_exception: !important allowed only in override utility classes (.mb_N, .mt_N, .txt_c, .txt_l, .txt_r, .back_no, .bd_l, .bd_r)
css.forbid_utility_classes_note: do not create font-family/font-weight utility classes (.landing_font_serif, .landing_weight_bold). apply typography through scoped parent selectors instead
css.forbid_utility_classes_exception: layout override utilities are allowed in reset/common: .mb_N .mt_N .mr_N .ml_N .pb_N .pt_N (margin/padding override), .txt_c .txt_l .txt_r (text-align override), .back_no .bd_l .bd_r (misc override), .pc_only .mb_only (responsive display)
css.inherit_from_parent_note: font-family, font-weight, color should be inherited from parent/section selector, not applied via utility class on every element

word_break.note: apply word-break:keep-all to all Korean text paragraphs and headings to ensure word-boundary line breaks

aspect_ratio.note: use aspect-ratio property for elements that need fixed width/height ratio. prefer over padding-bottom hack

multiline_ellipsis.note: for N-line text truncation with ellipsis. N is the max number of visible lines

bullet_dot_decorator.pattern: position:absolute; left:0; top:{N}px; width:3px; aspect-ratio:1/1; background-color:{color}; border-radius:50%; display:block; content:"";
bullet_dot_decorator.note: standard before/after bullet dot pattern for list items. use aspect-ratio:1/1 instead of height:3px

base_font_size.note: basic project: set base font-size with clamp on html/body. all rem values are relative to this base

root_vars.format: each variable on its own line inside :root{}
root_vars.note: CSS variables must follow naming pattern. semantic names forbidden. required vars must all be declared

breakpoints.note: 1024 is optional for tablet mid-range. use only when design requires it

sub_page.copy_from_existing_note: when project already has converted sub pages, copy common components as-is and only change menu active state and breadcrumb text
sub_page.css_append_to_existing_note: new sub page CSS must be appended to bottom of existing common.css, never modify existing rules
